text: The shooting happened on a street corner. The fear reached three schools.
asr: The shooting happened on a street corner. The fear reached three schools.

text: Just after one-thirty on the afternoon of October twenty-eighth, Atlanta police were called to Cleveland Avenue and Macon Drive. Fifty-six-year-old Darryl Callaway had been shot. He died.
asr: Just after 1:30 on the afternoon of October 28, Atlanta police were called to Cleveland Avenue and Macon Drive. 56-year-old Darryl Callaway had been shot. He died.

text: Police say it followed an argument with another man. Officers found a vehicle; a short chase ended in a crash, and the driver was detained. Being detained is not being convicted.
asr: Police say it followed an argument with another man. Officers found a vehicle; a short chase ended in a crash, and the driver was detained. Being detained is not being convicted.

text: Nearby, Cleveland Avenue, Hutchinson and Humphries elementary schools went into lockdown. Officials say every student and staff member was safe.

text: Bus routes changed, and school police helped students who walk home stay clear of the scene.

text: A man is dead. A family is grieving. And children at three schools had their afternoon rearranged around gunfire.
